title: Momentous decision looms after judges call for Netanyahu charges to be dropped
summary_full: Dropping of corruption charges against Israeli PM after unusual intervention could set damaging precedentThe Israeli judges presiding over Benjamin Netanyahu’s corruption trial have called on prosecutors to end proceedings, a highly unusual intervention that leaves the attorney general facing a momentous political decision.The prime minister has been charged with bribery, fraud and breach of trust in three complex and overlapping criminal cases that hinge on his relationship with telecoms magnates and other wealthy businessmen. Ending the trial without a ruling could set damaging precedents for media independence and how politicians are held to account. Continue reading...
